text:
Customer: Hi, quick flag — after the model version bump yesterday our help-center generator started returning much shorter answers with fewer clarifying bullets. Not a hard error but it removes context we rely on. Example:

Customer: PROMPT: 'How do I reset my API key and what happens to active sessions?'

Customer: BEFORE (redwood-v9.1):
```
You can reset your API key from the Console: Settings > API keys. Steps:
1) Navigate to Settings > API keys.
2) Click 'Rotate' next to the key.
3) Update any services using the old key.
Notes: Active sessions remain valid for up to 5 minutes while tokens propagate. If you have long-lived sessions, rotate during a maintenance window. Would you like a snippet to update the header?
```

Customer: AFTER (redwood-v9.2):
```
Go to Settings > API keys and rotate the key. Update your services.
```

Customer: The second reply drops the helpful bullets and the follow-up offer. It's small but breaks our doc generation pipeline.

Maya G: Thanks for the report — sorry about the disruption. Can you share the request_id(s) and the exact endpoint you called? Also was this via the hosted API or a Dedicated deployment?

Customer: Hosted API, endpoint /v1/generate. request_id: 2026-11-09-FF23. Happened across several requests between 2026-11-09T15:10 and 15:35Z.

Samir K: Curious if any system prompt or defaults changed with v9.2 (e.g., length_penalty, assistant persona). Can you paste the JSON body you used (headers redacted)?

Customer: Sure — here's the body we send:
```
{
  "model": "redwood-v9.2",
  "prompt": "How do I reset my API key and what happens to active sessions?",
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "max_tokens": 220,
  "top_p": 0.95
}
```

Eli Park: We promoted redwood-v9.2 to general yesterday at 2026-11-09T14:50Z after a canary window. No intentional persona removal, but there were tuning changes to reduce verbosity for short prompts to save token cost.

Eli Park: Can you repro with the exact request above and paste both raw responses (including whitespace/newlines)? Even small formatting differences help.

Customer: Reproduced now — attached both raw outputs (I pasted them above but sharing also as a file in case). Confirmed the after-response removes enumerated steps and the trailing offer to provide a snippet.

Support Bot: Ticket created: #SUP-18492. Adding labels: regression, model-behavior.

Samir K: For mitigation you can pin to redwood-v9.1 on your route to preserve the old style while we investigate. We'll also collect ~5 representative prompt-response pairs from you and run through our eval harness to see which decoding/tuning change caused this.

Samir K: Possible vectors: decoding defaults (length_penalty / repetition_penalty), new brevity-tuning in the safety head, or a post-filter that removes elaborative clauses for short prompts. We'll try reproducing with both v9.1 and v9.2 locally.

Maya G: Next steps for us: 1) Customer to upload 3–5 prompt/response pairs (done), 2) Eng-ML to run A/B with v9.1/v9.2 and snapshot decoding logits, 3) We'll propose rollback window if we confirm a regression. Expect an update in ~24h.

Customer: Thanks — pinning to v9.1 is fine short-term. Appreciate the quick triage.

Maya G: Noted. I'll tag model-onboard and ops for logs. Please keep examples coming if you see any other systematic cuts. :pray:
